ह्वे, i. 1, Par. Ātm. (in the Vedas also हू हू),
 1. To call,

= Rigv. i. 48, 14 (जुहूरे, ved. red. pf.).
 2. To name,
. To challenge, to vie with (with acc.),

(शशिनं ह्वयन्ती, Vying with the moon).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. हूत, Summoned, invited.
 --Comp.
 --With आ आ,
 I. Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm.,

= Rigv. vii. 16, 3 (आ जुह्वान, ptcple. pf. pass.).
 3. To invite,

(आह्वयाम् आस, anomal. pf.), 37, 10 (आह्वयान, anomal. ptcple. pres.).
 2. To emulate.
 --Caus. ह्वायय, To order to call,

.
 --With नि नि, To call down (from heaven),

= Rigv. i. 112, 24.
 --With प्र प्र, To call, Utt.

.
 --Cf. O.H.G. hweion; Goth. vôpjan (probably the regular Caus.); A.S. hweóp (cry, called out), and wepan; probably also cygan (3. conj., cl. जुहू); βοή, βοάω, probably ἀΰω and ἰωή; Lat. re-boare, and perhaps vovere, vōtum.
